name: The Embalmer's Heart
summary: In Duskwood, Eliza's buried corpse holds a heart that still beats. The Embalmer placed his own heart in his dead wife through dark magic, and it became the anchor of his power.

sections.title: A Love That Defied Death
sections.body: Darkshire's tales remember the Embalmer as a gentle alchemist. When his wife Eliza died, grief shattered his mind. He turned to foul sorcery, cut out his own heart, and placed it in her lifeless chest. The magic stirred her corpse to unlife, but the return twisted Eliza into a ravenous creature with an insatiable hunger for living human flesh. Horrified by what he had done, the alchemist buried her again.

sections.title: A Shield for Darkshire
sections.body: The Embalmer's heart still beats inside Eliza's tomb, sustaining his dark power. Mayor Ello Ebonlocke believes Darkshire can weaken the Embalmer's sorcery by destroying his reanimated bride and claiming the heart. If they secure it while it still beats, the town's leaders hope to turn its essence against the necromancer and make it a ward against his terrors.

faq.q: Why does Eliza have the Embalmer's heart?
aliases: why does eliza have the heart
faq.answer: Grief drove the Embalmer to place his own beating heart in Eliza's corpse with forbidden magic. The ritual brought her back to unlife, but left her ravenous for human flesh.

faq.q: Why does Mayor Ebonlocke want the heart brought back to Darkshire?
aliases: why does ello want the heart
what does darkshire do with heart
faq.answer: Mayor Ello Ebonlocke hopes the heart's dark magic can weaken the Embalmer and become a ward to protect Darkshire.

faq.q: How does the Embalmer survive without his heart?
aliases: how is embalmer alive without heart
faq.answer: The Embalmer bound his life force and power to the heart through dark sorcery. It still beats inside his wife's buried remains, while he endures without it.

faq.q: Where can the heart be found?
faq.answer: The heart lies inside Eliza, buried in a hidden grave plot in Duskwood. It can be claimed only by confronting and defeating the ravenous bride, brought back to unlife.

angles.text: As a warlock, you can recognize the heart's role in anchoring necromantic unlife through fleshcraft and the binding of a soul.
As a human, you hear the beleaguered people of Duskwood whisper of the kindly alchemist's tragic fall.
